assets.name: Blind Eel
assets.description: A pale, eyeless eel that has grown fat in the drowned lower levels on lamp-oil and scholars. It hunts by the heat of a lantern, so you are the loudest thing in the room.

source.desc: A pale, eyeless eel that has grown fat in the drowned lower levels on lamp-oil and scholars. It hunts by the heat of a lantern, so you are the loudest thing in the room.

assets.name: Bright Wraith
assets.description: The opposite of a shade: a figure made of light so bright it leaves a shape burned on the inside of your lids. It is not warm. It is only bright, and it is very close.

source.desc: The opposite of a shade: a figure made of light so bright it leaves a shape burned on the inside of your lids. It is not warm. It is only bright, and it is very close.

assets.name: Cinderhound
assets.description: A lean hunting-dog with a coat of grey ash and a mouth full of coals. Kaldrec's kennel-hounds once guarded his forge. They still do, and they are hungry for the first time in three centuries.

source.desc: A lean hunting-dog with a coat of grey ash and a mouth full of coals. Kaldrec's kennel-hounds once guarded his forge. They still do, and they are hungry for the first time in three centuries.

assets.name: Clockwork Crab
assets.description: A brass crab the size of a table, wound up by the tide, ticking. It was built to clean the lenses. Now it cleans away anything that blocks the view.

source.desc: A brass crab the size of a table, wound up by the tide, ticking. It was built to clean the lenses. Now it cleans away anything that blocks the view.

assets.name: Cocoon Husk
assets.description: A body wrapped in silk from ankle to crown and hung from the Warren ceiling to ripen. Whatever was inside has left. Something else has moved in, and it is restless, and it is hatching.

source.desc: A body wrapped in silk from ankle to crown and hung from the Warren ceiling to ripen. Whatever was inside has left. Something else has moved in, and it is restless, and it is hatching.

assets.name: Corona
assets.description: A ring of flame with nothing at its centre, drifting through the deep like a halo without a head. It sings, very faintly, in a voice that sounds like someone you were once fond of.

source.desc: A ring of flame with nothing at its centre, drifting through the deep like a halo without a head. It sings, very faintly, in a voice that sounds like someone you were once fond of.

assets.name: Dawnhusk
assets.description: A Lanternbearer who reached the Sunken Sun and looked at it. What is left is dry and bright and brittle as a moth's wing, and it glows from the inside, like a paper lantern with a fire in it.

source.desc: A Lanternbearer who reached the Sunken Sun and looked at it. What is left is dry and bright and brittle as a moth's wing, and it glows from the inside, like a paper lantern with a fire in it.

assets.name: Deathshead
assets.description: A hawk-moth the size of a horse, with a skull-shaped mark across its back. It screams like a child when it lands, and when it stops screaming the lamps go out.

source.desc: A hawk-moth the size of a horse, with a skull-shaped mark across its back. It screams like a child when it lands, and when it stops screaming the lamps go out.

assets.name: Deeplamp
assets.description: The miners hung safety lamps at the bottom of every shaft. Some of the lamps went out. Some of the flames did not, and climbed down out of the glass to look for oil.

source.desc: The miners hung safety lamps at the bottom of every shaft. Some of the lamps went out. Some of the flames did not, and climbed down out of the glass to look for oil.

assets.name: Dimflame
assets.description: A lamp-flame that has burned so long without being lit that it forgot what it was for. It gives no light. It gives a sort of pale, sad heat, and it takes your light in exchange.

source.desc: A lamp-flame that has burned so long without being lit that it forgot what it was for. It gives no light. It gives a sort of pale, sad heat, and it takes your light in exchange.

assets.name: Drowned Astronomer
assets.description: A hooded scholar of the Observatory, still with a brass eyepiece screwed into the veil where an eye would be. The water rose over the dome on the night the sky closed. He is still taking the measurements.

source.desc: A hooded scholar of the Observatory, still with a brass eyepiece screwed into the veil where an eye would be. The water rose over the dome on the night the sky closed. He is still taking the measurements.

assets.name: Dustmoth Swarm
assets.description: Ten thousand moths the colour of old ash, moving as one body. Wherever they settle, the light thins. Wherever they lift, the walls are a shade darker.

source.desc: Ten thousand moths the colour of old ash, moving as one body. Wherever they settle, the light thins. Wherever they lift, the walls are a shade darker.

assets.name: Eclipsemaw
assets.description: A disc of darkness with a mouth in the middle and a corona of teeth, gliding through the bright water. The Gloam did not make it. The Radiant did, to eat whatever is left of the dark.

source.desc: A disc of darkness with a mouth in the middle and a corona of teeth, gliding through the bright water. The Gloam did not make it. The Radiant did, to eat whatever is left of the dark.

assets.name: Emberwisp
assets.description: A spark from Kaldrec's forge that never cooled and never landed. It drifts across the Cinderwaste on the hot wind, looking for something to set alight. Lanterns are its favourite.

source.desc: A spark from Kaldrec's forge that never cooled and never landed. It drifts across the Cinderwaste on the hot wind, looking for something to set alight. Lanterns are its favourite.

assets.name: Furnace Knight
assets.description: One of Kaldrec's armour-bearers: a hooded knight whose plate is welded shut over a working forge. The visor glows. The steam vents from the joints. He served the Sunforger for three hundred years, and asked for nothing.

source.desc: One of Kaldrec's armour-bearers: a hooded knight whose plate is welded shut over a working forge. The visor glows. The steam vents from the joints. He served the Sunforger for three hundred years, and asked for nothing.

assets.name: Glass Golem
assets.description: A giant of fused sand, poured into a man-shape in Kaldrec's kilns and left to cool. It is clear as a window, and lit from within by a small furnace that has burned for three hundred years.

source.desc: A giant of fused sand, poured into a man-shape in Kaldrec's kilns and left to cool. It is clear as a window, and lit from within by a small furnace that has burned for three hundred years.

assets.name: Glasswalker
assets.description: A traveller whose flesh was fired to glass when the Black Noon first opened. Its hood and veil are fused smooth to what is beneath. It walks the dunes in a straight line, and it rings faintly with each step.

source.desc: A traveller whose flesh was fired to glass when the Black Noon first opened. Its hood and veil are fused smooth to what is beneath. It walks the dunes in a straight line, and it rings faintly with each step.

assets.name: Hollow Miner
assets.description: A miner of the Weeping Mines, still in his leather hood and cracked lamp-helm. The shift whistle blew three hundred years ago. He is still on shift, and he has noticed you are not.

source.desc: A miner of the Weeping Mines, still in his leather hood and cracked lamp-helm. The shift whistle blew three hundred years ago. He is still on shift, and he has noticed you are not.

assets.name: Kaldrec the Sunforger
assets.description: The first Lanternsmith, hooded and veiled in a smith's scorched leather, standing over a forge gone cold in a desert of glass. He made the lanterns from the Radiant's own eye. He made the first Key. He kept the receipts.

source.desc: The first Lanternsmith, hooded and veiled in a smith's scorched leather, standing over a forge gone cold in a desert of glass. He made the lanterns from the Radiant's own eye. He made the first Key. He kept the receipts.

phase2.txt: Kaldrec drops his hammer and takes up the forge itself. The whole desert glows red. "Every lantern I made was a promise," he says, "and you are the last one I have left to keep."

assets.name: Faceless Key-Bearer
assets.description: A hooded, veiled Lanternbearer with a key-lantern of its own, and a stance you know. It was a Key that failed. It fights the way you do, and it wears your silence like a second veil.

source.desc: A hooded, veiled Lanternbearer with a key-lantern of its own, and a stance you know. It was a Key that failed. It fights the way you do, and it wears your silence like a second veil.

assets.name: Lampmoth
assets.description: A moth the size of a cart-wheel with a lantern-glow behind each wing, patterned like a wide and patient eye. It follows lit lanterns the way tides follow the moon, and for the same reason.

source.desc: A moth the size of a cart-wheel with a lantern-glow behind each wing, patterned like a wide and patient eye. It follows lit lanterns the way tides follow the moon, and for the same reason.

assets.name: Lampshade
assets.description: The shadow thrown by one of the nine lamps, which has learned to walk without the lamp. It follows the light of a lantern and stands just behind you, where the shadow should be. It stands there a little too long.

source.desc: The shadow thrown by one of the nine lamps, which has learned to walk without the lamp. It follows the light of a lantern and stands just behind you, where the shadow should be. It stands there a little too long.

assets.name: Lampwarden
assets.description: An iron lamp-post walking on brass legs, its glass head lit with a flame that does not flicker. It was built to keep the lamps of the Hall alight. It has decided that includes yours.

source.desc: An iron lamp-post walking on brass legs, its glass head lit with a flame that does not flicker. It was built to keep the lamps of the Hall alight. It has decided that includes yours.

assets.name: Lens-Eye
assets.description: A great ground-glass lens on brass legs, wandering the flooded galleries. It was built to look at the stars. It has spent three hundred years looking at everything else, and it burns what it finds.

source.desc: A great ground-glass lens on brass legs, wandering the flooded galleries. It was built to look at the stars. It has spent three hundred years looking at everything else, and it burns what it finds.

assets.name: Maelis, the Ninth Lamplighter
assets.description: The last of the Nine, veiled in grey wool, four hundred years old and not one day tired. She kept you like a good tool: oiled, sharpened, and never asked whether you minded. She loves you. She has a lantern for you, and it does not have a wick.

source.desc: The last of the Nine, veiled in grey wool, four hundred years old and not one day tired. She kept you like a good tool: oiled, sharpened, and never asked whether you minded. She loves you. She has a lantern for you, and it does not have a wick.

phase2.txt: Maelis unshutters the ninth lamp at last. Warm light floods the Hall, and she is smiling behind the veil. "There now. It is only a little pain. It is only a little longer."

assets.name: Moth-Keeper
assets.description: A veiled breeder of the old Silkwrights, robed in cocoon-cloth from crown to hem. She tends the Warren's moths as a shepherd tends a flock, and she has not yet decided that you are not one of them.

source.desc: A veiled breeder of the old Silkwrights, robed in cocoon-cloth from crown to hem. She tends the Warren's moths as a shepherd tends a flock, and she has not yet decided that you are not one of them.

assets.name: The Moth-Mother
assets.description: Queen of the Warren, a grey moth as broad as the cavern, wrapped in a veil of her own silk. Every cocoon on the ceiling is hers. Every light she has ever put out hangs there in a row, still warm.

source.desc: Queen of the Warren, a grey moth as broad as the cavern, wrapped in a veil of her own silk. Every cocoon on the ceiling is hers. Every light she has ever put out hangs there in a row, still warm.

phase2.txt: The Moth-Mother shreds her own veil. Beneath it is a face made of a hundred thousand tiny eyes, and every one of them is looking at your lantern.

assets.name: Oathbound
assets.description: A hooded Lamplighter who swore the vigil oath and never asked to be released. The oath has kept the body upright long after the rest of him left. It speaks the words very quietly, over and over.

source.desc: A hooded Lamplighter who swore the vigil oath and never asked to be released. The oath has kept the body upright long after the rest of him left. It speaks the words very quietly, over and over.

assets.name: The Orrery Sovereign
assets.description: The great engine at the heart of the Observatory: nine brass spheres turning on nine rings around a lens as tall as a house. It was built to predict the sun. It predicts you, and every turn it is a little more right.

source.desc: The great engine at the heart of the Observatory: nine brass spheres turning on nine rings around a lens as tall as a house. It was built to predict the sun. It predicts you, and every turn it is a little more right.

phase2.txt: The Sovereign's rings tear loose of their axles and spin free. The lens swings toward you, and in it you see your hooded self, very small, a long way down.

assets.name: The Radiant
assets.description: The true sun, asleep beneath the lid of the Gloam, and no longer quite asleep. It is not a god and it is not a monster. It is a hunger that warms. It has waited a very long time to speak with the one who was made to close its eye.

source.desc: The true sun, asleep beneath the lid of the Gloam, and no longer quite asleep. It is not a god and it is not a monster. It is a hunger that warms. It has waited a very long time to speak with the one who was made to close its eye.

phase2.txt: The Radiant tilts its gaze and the dark dissolves. Its corona unfurls to fill the chamber, and the air itself begins to burn.

phase3.txt: The light stops shouting. It speaks softly, in your own voice: "I am not lying to you. I have never lied to you. Would you like a face?"

assets.name: Sigil Knight
assets.description: The Lamplighters' champion of the Hall: a knight veiled in white and armoured in plates etched with the nine sigils. When he raises his sword, the lamps lean toward him like plants toward a window.

source.desc: The Lamplighters' champion of the Hall: a knight veiled in white and armoured in plates etched with the nine sigils. When he raises his sword, the lamps lean toward him like plants toward a window.

assets.name: Slag Brute
assets.description: A hulking press-man cast from smelter waste and fused with the hollow shell of a foreman's lantern-carrier. It still carries the lamp. Nothing that tries to take it comes back with hands.

source.desc: A hulking press-man cast from smelter waste and fused with the hollow shell of a foreman's lantern-carrier. It still carries the lamp. Nothing that tries to take it comes back with hands.

assets.name: Slagworm
assets.description: A blind worm as long as a mine cart, grown fat on the runoff of the old smelters. It glows a sullen orange along the seams of its hide and leaves glass in its wake.

source.desc: A blind worm as long as a mine cart, grown fat on the runoff of the old smelters. It glows a sullen orange along the seams of its hide and leaves glass in its wake.

assets.name: Sphere Warden
assets.description: A guardian of nested brass rings, spinning in three planes around a hooded shape that may once have been a scholar. It was left to guard the great orrery, and it has never once let the rings stop.

source.desc: A guardian of nested brass rings, spinning in three planes around a hooded shape that may once have been a scholar. It was left to guard the great orrery, and it has never once let the rings stop.

assets.name: Stonechewer
assets.description: A boring-engine of iron teeth and bronze gears, built to eat the mountain. When the crew fled it kept eating, and it has run out of mountain and started on the timbers.

source.desc: A boring-engine of iron teeth and bronze gears, built to eat the mountain. When the crew fled it kept eating, and it has run out of mountain and started on the timbers.

assets.name: Sun-Scarred
assets.description: A wanderer wrapped from crown to boot in scorched linen, whose mask was burned into the skin beneath. It did not look away from the Black Noon. It says the sun told it a secret, and it will tell you.

source.desc: A wanderer wrapped from crown to boot in scorched linen, whose mask was burned into the skin beneath. It did not look away from the Black Noon. It says the sun told it a secret, and it will tell you.

assets.name: Sun Warden
assets.description: A colossus of black iron and captive light, forged to stand between the Radiant and the door. Its chest is an open furnace with a small white sun inside, and the sun has seen you and is pleased.

source.desc: A colossus of black iron and captive light, forged to stand between the Radiant and the door. Its chest is an open furnace with a small white sun inside, and the sun has seen you and is pleased.

assets.name: Tide Wraith
assets.description: The water that filled the Observatory remembers drowning the astronomers. It has taken their shapes and stands in the flooded corridors with its hands open, pretending to plead.

source.desc: The water that filled the Observatory remembers drowning the astronomers. It has taken their shapes and stands in the flooded corridors with its hands open, pretending to plead.

assets.name: Wickcrawler
assets.description: A pale, many-legged thing that lives in the lamp-oil channels of the Hall, feeding on wicks. It has a lamp-flame growing from its back like a mushroom, and it does not mind being set alight.

source.desc: A pale, many-legged thing that lives in the lamp-oil channels of the Hall, feeding on wicks. It has a lamp-flame growing from its back like a mushroom, and it does not mind being set alight.

assets.name: Ember Draught
assets.description: Restores 35% HP and 35% Focus, and takes 15 Dread off.

source.desc: Restores 35% HP and 35% Focus, and takes 15 Dread off.

assets.name: Greater Red Draught
assets.description: Restores 60% of your HP.

source.desc: Restores 60% of your HP.

assets.name: Greater Mind Salts
assets.description: Restores 80% of your Focus.

source.desc: Restores 80% of your Focus.

assets.name: Lantern Flask
assets.description: A full flask of clean resin-oil. Refills 100 Light in your lantern.

source.desc: A full flask of clean resin-oil. Refills 100 Light in your lantern.

assets.name: Nightleaf Tonic
assets.description: The whispers go quiet. -60 Dread and cures ailments.

source.desc: The whispers go quiet. -60 Dread and cures ailments.

assets.name: Phoenix Ash
assets.description: Carry it and death may think twice. Once per fight, a killing blow returns you at 40% HP. Consumed automatically.

source.desc: Carry it and death may think twice. Once per fight, a killing blow returns you at 40% HP. Consumed automatically.

assets.name: Starwater
assets.description: Water from a drowned sky. Fully restores HP, cures all ailments and clears all Dread.

source.desc: Water from a drowned sky. Fully restores HP, cures all ailments and clears all Dread.

assets.name: Stoneskin Draught
assets.description: Your skin greys and hardens. -35% damage taken until the fight ends.

source.desc: Your skin greys and hardens. -35% damage taken until the fight ends.

assets.name: Sunbomb
assets.description: A glass sphere of caged noon. Heavy magic damage to all enemies and sets them burning.

source.desc: A glass sphere of caged noon. Heavy magic damage to all enemies and sets them burning.

assets.name: Voidflask
assets.description: A flask of bottled nothing. Magic damage to all enemies and weakens them.

source.desc: A flask of bottled nothing. Magic damage to all enemies and weakens them.

assets.name: Ward-Salt
assets.description: Scatter a ring of salt. Absorbs damage equal to 35% of your max HP.

source.desc: Scatter a ring of salt. Absorbs damage equal to 35% of your max HP.

assets.name: Elixir of War
assets.description: Bitter and hot. +30% damage until the fight ends.

source.desc: Bitter and hot. +30% damage until the fight ends.

assets.name: Ember Ore
assets.description: Rock that still glows from a fire nobody lit. Fuel for the Ember Forge.

source.desc: Rock that still glows from a fire nobody lit. Fuel for the Ember Forge.

assets.name: Lamp Resin
assets.description: Amber gum from wicks that burned too long. It smells of sweet smoke and old vigils.

source.desc: Amber gum from wicks that burned too long. It smells of sweet smoke and old vigils.

assets.name: Starglass
assets.description: Glass drawn from drowned lenses and dead constellations. It remembers light.

source.desc: Glass drawn from drowned lenses and dead constellations. It remembers light.

assets.name: Sunsteel Ingot
assets.description: Steel quenched in the Radiant's own glare. It gives back more warmth than it should.

source.desc: Steel quenched in the Radiant's own glare. It gives back more warmth than it should.

assets.name: Voidsilk
assets.description: Thread spun from the dark between webs. You feel it more than you see it.

source.desc: Thread spun from the dark between webs. You feel it more than you see it.

assets.name: The Astronomer's Log
assets.description: A waterlogged log, the ink run to blue clouds. The last legible line: "The sun is not setting. It is closing."

source.desc: A waterlogged log, the ink run to blue clouds. The last legible line: "The sun is not setting. It is closing."

assets.name: The Cold Key
assets.description: A key of black iron, cold in the hottest room. It opens the one vault in the Cinderwaste that Kaldrec never fired.

source.desc: A key of black iron, cold in the hottest room. It opens the one vault in the Cinderwaste that Kaldrec never fired.

assets.name: The First Faceplate
assets.description: A smooth, blank plate of pale metal, hammered to fit a face. It has no eye-holes. Kaldrec made it for the first Key, and it is still the right size.

source.desc: A smooth, blank plate of pale metal, hammered to fit a face. It has no eye-holes. Kaldrec made it for the first Key, and it is still the right size.

assets.name: The Foreman's Lamp
assets.description: A miner's lamp with a name scratched on the base. The flame does not flicker, and it does not go out underwater.

source.desc: A miner's lamp with a name scratched on the base. The flame does not flicker, and it does not go out underwater.

assets.name: The Glass Rose
assets.description: A rose blown of clear sand-glass, every petal perfect. Someone left it on a grave with no name and no body.

source.desc: A rose blown of clear sand-glass, every petal perfect. Someone left it on a grave with no name and no body.

assets.name: Moth-Silk Bolt
assets.description: A bolt of pale silk spun by something that never stopped. Soft, light, and it hums when a lamp is lit near it.

source.desc: A bolt of pale silk spun by something that never stopped. Soft, light, and it hums when a lamp is lit near it.

assets.name: The Nine Sigils
assets.description: Nine brass discs, one for each Lamplighter, each cut with a lamp. Eight are dull. One is still warm.

source.desc: Nine brass discs, one for each Lamplighter, each cut with a lamp. Eight are dull. One is still warm.

assets.name: The Ninth Letter
assets.description: A sealed letter in a tired, careful hand, addressed to "Whoever comes last." The wax is a lamp with nine flames, eight of them scratched out.

source.desc: A sealed letter in a tired, careful hand, addressed to "Whoever comes last." The wax is a lamp with nine flames, eight of them scratched out.

assets.name: The Star Chart
assets.description: A drowned astronomer's chart of the sky as it was. Nine stars are circled in wax pencil; the ninth is scratched out until the paper tore.

source.desc: A drowned astronomer's chart of the sky as it was. Nine stars are circled in wax pencil; the ninth is scratched out until the paper tore.

assets.name: Sunglass
assets.description: A palm-sized shard of desert glass, fused by a light that no longer shines. Look into it and it looks back, warm.

source.desc: A palm-sized shard of desert glass, fused by a light that no longer shines. Look into it and it looks back, warm.

assets.name: Ashen Gauntlets
assets.description: Gloves of fused ash, still hot to the touch. Whatever they grip, they leave a print in.

source.lore: Gloves of fused ash, still hot to the touch. Whatever they grip, they leave a print in.

assets.name: Atlas of Ends
assets.description: A book of maps to places that have not ended yet. The last page is blank, and the blank page is yours.

source.lore: A book of maps to places that have not ended yet. The last page is blank, and the blank page is yours.

assets.name: Cinder Ring
assets.description: A ring of black glass with one coal set in it. The coal has been burning since before the ring was made.

source.lore: A ring of black glass with one coal set in it. The coal has been burning since before the ring was made.

assets.name: Dawnsmith
assets.description: A Lamplighter smith's hammer, struck against a black anvil on the day the sun was put to sleep. It still rings when something wakes.

source.lore: A Lamplighter smith's hammer, struck against a black anvil on the day the sun was put to sleep. It still rings when something wakes.

assets.name: Eclipse Mace
assets.description: One face bright, one face black. The Lamplighters swung it bright side down, so that the dark would remember who was asking.

source.lore: One face bright, one face black. The Lamplighters swung it bright side down, so that the dark would remember who was asking.

assets.name: Emberplate
assets.description: Plate that was quenched in ash instead of water. Anything that strikes it comes away with singed fingers and second thoughts.

source.lore: Plate that was quenched in ash instead of water. Anything that strikes it comes away with singed fingers and second thoughts.

assets.name: The Foreman's Pick
assets.description: The Ironforeman never once put it down. The shaft is worn to the shape of a hand that no longer needs to be there.

source.lore: The Ironforeman never once put it down. The shaft is worn to the shape of a hand that no longer needs to be there.

assets.name: The Gaoler's Chain
assets.description: Each link was forged for a prisoner and given a name. The chain is heavy with them, and it hits back for all of them.

source.lore: Each link was forged for a prisoner and given a name. The chain is heavy with them, and it hits back for all of them.

assets.name: Glass Edge
assets.description: Sand fused by the Radiant's first glance, ground to an edge one grain wide. It cuts light, sound and, on a good day, doubt.

source.lore: Sand fused by the Radiant's first glance, ground to an edge one grain wide. It cuts light, sound and, on a good day, doubt.

assets.name: The Hungering Scythe
assets.description: A scythe of frozen night that was never sharpened, only fed. It takes what it cuts and is never quite full.

source.lore: A scythe of frozen night that was never sharpened, only fed. It takes what it cuts and is never quite full.

assets.name: The Lamplighter's Crook
assets.description: A hooked staff for lifting the wicks of the tallest lamps. Every Lamplighter carried one. This one has lifted rather more than wicks.

source.lore: A hooked staff for lifting the wicks of the tallest lamps. Every Lamplighter carried one. This one has lifted rather more than wicks.

assets.name: Veil of the Moth-Mother
assets.description: Ten thousand wings, stitched by patient hands. When the lamps gutter, it flutters toward the light and takes you with it.

source.lore: Ten thousand wings, stitched by patient hands. When the lamps gutter, it flutters toward the light and takes you with it.

assets.name: The Nameless Hood
assets.description: Whoever wears it is forgotten by the next room. Whoever made it was forgotten first, which is how it works so well.

source.lore: Whoever wears it is forgotten by the next room. Whoever made it was forgotten first, which is how it works so well.

assets.name: Nebula Robe
assets.description: Cloth woven from the dust between the stars. Every fold is a small night with a few cold lights in it.

source.lore: Cloth woven from the dust between the stars. Every fold is a small night with a few cold lights in it.

assets.name: Nightveil Talons
assets.description: Worn by a masked duellist who walked between the veils and was never seen to arrive. The blades are still wet, and it is not rain.

source.lore: Worn by a masked duellist who walked between the veils and was never seen to arrive. The blades are still wet, and it is not rain.

assets.name: The Ninth Lamp
assets.description: The last lamp of the last Lamplighter. Maelis carried it four hundred years, and the flame has never once been fed.

source.lore: The last lamp of the last Lamplighter. Maelis carried it four hundred years, and the flame has never once been fed.

assets.name: Eye of the Orrery
assets.description: The lens at the centre of the Sovereign. It has watched every star wheel past and has opinions about the last one.

source.lore: The lens at the centre of the Sovereign. It has watched every star wheel past and has opinions about the last one.

assets.name: Polaris
assets.description: The astronomers pointed it at the one star that never moved. The star has since moved. The staff still points where it was.

source.lore: The astronomers pointed it at the one star that never moved. The star has since moved. The staff still points where it was.

assets.name: Crown of the Radiant
assets.description: A ring of pale fire that fits no head and every head. It speaks to whoever wears it, in their own voice, and it is very kind.

source.lore: A ring of pale fire that fits no head and every head. It speaks to whoever wears it, in their own voice, and it is very kind.

assets.name: Starmap Amulet
assets.description: An engraved chart of a sky that has since been rearranged. It is accurate only for those who remember the old one.

source.lore: An engraved chart of a sky that has since been rearranged. It is accurate only for those who remember the old one.

assets.name: Hammer of the Sunforger
assets.description: Kaldrec beat the first lantern out of a sliver of the Radiant's eye with this. The head is still warm, and it is not from the forge.

source.lore: Kaldrec beat the first lantern out of a sliver of the Radiant's eye with this. The head is still warm, and it is not from the forge.

assets.name: Sunspear Arbalest
assets.description: It fires a bolt of pure noon. By the time you hear the string, the target has already been noticed by the sun.

source.lore: It fires a bolt of pure noon. By the time you hear the string, the target has already been noticed by the sun.

assets.name: Tidewalker Boots
assets.description: Salvaged from a drowned astronomer who kept walking. The soles never touch the floor, only what floods it.

assets.name: Umbral Fang
assets.description: It is drawn before the hand decides to. Its first cut is always the worst one, and it likes to be the first.

assets.name: The Warden's Bulwark
assets.description: The jailers of the Nine stood behind it while the sun screamed. The dents on the face are all on the inside.
